# Jean Carlos — Portfolio

> Personal portfolio of Jean Carlos, Full Stack Software Developer (.NET/C# and Angular),
> 5 years of experience building ERP and SaaS systems.

Built as an Astro static site with React islands for interactive components (LetterGlitch
animation, SkillsList).

## Links

- [Live site](https://jeancsm94.github.io)
- [GitHub](https://github.com/jeancsm94)
- [LinkedIn](https://www.linkedin.com/in/jeancsm94)

## Stack

- **Astro** -- static site generator and component orchestrator
- **React 19** -- interactive islands
- **Angular** -- primary frontend framework used professionally
- **.NET/C#** -- primary backend stack
- **Tailwind CSS** -- utility-first styling
- **TypeScript** -- type checking across `.astro` and `.tsx` files
- **Montserrat** (Fontsource variable) -- primary typeface

## Optional

- Based on the [Dark Minimal](https://github.com/Gothsec/dark-minimal) template by Gothsec, licensed under MIT.
